extraction_notes: BC847BLT1G is the SOT-23 Pb-free tape/reel orderable of BC847B; extraction uses the BC847B rows of the shared BC846ALT1G-series tables and the BC847B/BC848B/BC849B/BC850B curve group on pages 7-8 (Figures 19-27), not the A-grade (pages 3-4) or BC846B-only (pages 5-6) curve groups.
All curve points are hand-digitized 25 C typical curves read from log-axis figures; expect roughly 5-10 percent reading error, larger near steep roll-offs (hFE above 0.1 A in Figure 20).

Guaranteed table bounds are kept as bounds: hFE min 200 / max 450 at 2 mA, VCE(sat) 0.25 V and 0.6 V maxima, fT 100 MHz minimum, Cobo 4.5 pF maximum, V(BR)CEO 45 V minimum. None were recast as typical values.

VBE(on) table values (min 580 mV / typ 660 mV / max 700 mV at IC = 2.0 mA, VCE = 5.0 V; max 770 mV at IC = 10 mA) are captured via the Figure 23 curve; the digitized point at 2 mA (0.67 V) agrees with the 660 mV table typical.

Figure 24 (collector saturation region, VCE vs IB families) and Figure 25 (VBE temperature coefficient) were examined but not digitized; Figures 20-23 and 26-27 already cover the model-relevant behavior.
Only public onsemi datasheet evidence used; no vendor SPICE models or model packs consulted.
